title: Additive closure of selected-geodesic convexity
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Theorem 1.4.5 proof on PDF p. 46: the KL functional is split into energy and entropy, their geodesic convexity moduli are established separately, and then combined; https://chewisinho.github.io/main.pdf#page=46
target_statement: For the ASTIS predicate IsAlphaGeodesicallyConvex on a fixed selected-geodesic family, if F is alpha-geodesically convex and G is beta-geodesically convex, then x ↦ F x + G x is (alpha+beta)-geodesically convex. Derive the zero-modulus and constant-addition specializations used when assembling energy + entropy + normalization constants.

searched: Open transport/Brenier PRs #194-#205 to avoid competing shared-file edits
shared_floor_audit.notes: Samplinglib already has the source-normalized selected-geodesic predicate and first-order consequence, but no additive closure theorem. Mathlib has linear-space convexity closure, not this route-neutral selected-geodesic interface. The lemma is a common geometric closure node for the Chewi Wasserstein KL proof and Boumal/Riemannian geodesic-convexity route, so it must not be introduced as a SampleWiki-local duplicate. The implementation stays in a new isolated Geometry module and does not touch the Measure/transport stabilization lane.
